first_investigation.candidate_comparison_before_generation: Three arms on a new fixed 100-question screen: original dynamic; matched-first vector excluding non-generated predecessor rows; predecessor-delimiter vector using exactly those same rows and labels. Both new vectors are scaled to the original raw-vector Euclidean norm to isolate orientation and hold dynamic parameters fixed. Matched-first is a confound control, not an optimization claim. No vectors combined.
first_investigation.generation_gate: Candidate must reduce mean thinking AND total tokens by at least 5%, have no fewer correct answers and no more caps than BOTH original dynamic and matched-first control. One run per arm. If passing, freeze candidate and confirm on independent reserved 200 training questions with fresh original dynamic; no parameter search on screen or reserve. Report paired uncertainty, not proven accuracy preservation.
